persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrījaya bhūpatīndramalladevasana cukacāsa deva pratiṣṭhā siddhāgni ayutāhuti yajña yāṅāyā

date.as_written: saṃ 825 bhādrapada śukla daśamī mūla śanīścaravārakuhnu

purpose: cukacāsa deva pratiṣṭhā siddhāgni ayutāhuti yajña
notes: The manuscript was copied/used for the installation of deities and the ayutāhuti yajña performed by King Jayabhūpatīndramalla at Cukacā (a courtyard in the Bhaktapur palace).
